title: Suspicious PowerShell Encoded Command or In-Memory Download
author: Damir Sadikov
description:
Detects PowerShell process creation with command-line patterns associated
with obfuscation and fileless execution: encoded commands (-EncodedCommand),
hidden windows, execution-policy bypass, and in-memory download cradles
(DownloadString / IEX). These are common in initial access and execution
stages of commodity malware and post-exploitation frameworks.
